title: Invariant complex structures on SL(2,C)
summary: We classify the left-invariant complex structures on the real Lie group SL(2,C) up to Lie group automorphism. The classification consists of the bi-invariant complex structure, a family parameterised by the unit disk, and one new, non-regular complex structure. The topology of the space of left-invariant complex structures (modulo automorphisms) is not Hausdorff. Finally, we show that the corresponding complex manifolds always admit left-invariant balanced metrics.
